statement: Unmodified cut_bounds commit 6b720fe57bfe2a3c8fffc51521d00b31011aa1a3 reproduces the published positive-rho certificate: h_+^2 <= 3.99929096609, worst slab [0.38625,0.3875], 90 accepted slabs / 150 attempts.
assumptions: Unmodified published script; dependency and command versions in reproduction_metadata.json.
gap: Reproduction of a published certificate, not a new theorem or independent audit.

statement: Uncertified numerical instrument: the literal published-center h_+ crosses 2 at rho approximately 0.43251274; the mean-zero J_+-weighted operator norm crosses 2 at approximately 0.44101422. At rho=.4, HS/operator=1.0094343378. Three root refinements and independent J/K/centering controls agree as logged.
assumptions: Heilman Appendix A kernels (145),(148),(149), fixed binary64 center (150).
Gauss-Legendre Nystrom quadrature on finite x domains; rho sampled on [.4,.95].
Weighted mean-zero projection is enforced; arithmetic is binary64.
gap: No rigorous discretization, tail or root enclosure; no new noise-stability theorem.

statement: At each requested rho in {.45,.5,.6,.7,.8,.9}, 81 radial coupling values and the saved scalar/simplex grids show no violation above 1e-10 of the stronger scalar bound, (139), or (142). Maximum signed (139) residual is 6.66e-16. Lemma A.2 and Corollary A.3 are already stated for every a>=0, independent of a rho restriction.
assumptions: Scalar p,q in [0,1]; vector p,q in Delta_3.
Each a grid spans 0 to 98*rho/(1-rho^2), with logarithmic small-a points.
Bessel-series truncation and all arithmetic are uncertified binary64; selected truncations doubled.
sources: 2608.00333v1 Lemma A.2 pp.38-40 and Corollary A.3 p.40
gap: Finite grids do not prove a universal inequality or exclude failures between tested points; source theorem is attributed, not a new proof.
